description: Regional festivals and events for Delhi NCR shopkeepers

events.name: Diwali Shopping Rush (Delhi)
events.stock_hint: Gift packs, Electronics, Sweets, Dry fruits, Clothes — Lajpat Nagar, Sarojini surge

events.name: Holi (Delhi)
events.stock_hint: Gulal, Bhang, Thandai, Pichkari, Cold drinks — massive city party

events.name: Eid (Delhi)
events.stock_hint: Sewai, Dates, Biryani masala, Ittar, Halwa — Jama Masjid area huge

events.name: Karwa Chauth
events.stock_hint: Karwa set, Mehendi, Mithai, Jewellery items, Sargi items

events.name: Lohri (Delhi/NCR)
events.stock_hint: Rewri, Gajak, Peanuts, Popcorn, Til — Punjabi community in Delhi is massive

events.name: Republic Day (Delhi)
events.stock_hint: Tricolor items, Sweets, Cold drinks — schools/offices buy heavily

events.name: Navratri (Delhi)
events.stock_hint: Farali items, Sabudana, Kuttu, Singhara atta, Fruits, Dahi
